$about: Questions for Tim: what a check cannot answer (a look on a real device, a choice). The report's first page («What needs you») lists the open ones with answer buttons; a button copies the answer to paste into a chat with Claude, who records it with `node design/checks/answer.mjs <id> "<answer>" ["note"]`.

about: the files the question is about. An answer is stored with those files' fingerprints (git blob hashes): when one of them changes, the question opens again («changed since your answer»), so an OK given to an older build never covers a newer one.
needs: iphone | mac-safari | eye (look at it anywhere) | choice. link: where to look (the live site unless a PR preview is named).
status: open | answered. A question can also be closed by a decision (answer.decision) or dropped (status: dropped, with why).

questions.ask: The review page on your devices: the System tabs one by one (the Type slider), zooming a chart on Responsive (trackpad pinch in Safari), the Typesetter demo — on your Mac in Safari and on your iPhone. Does each work?
Reload the home page a few times (and once as a first visit): does the team picture in the hero still shake or jump in Safari on your Mac and on your iPhone?
Right after the page loads, scroll fast to the bottom: are the drawings of the cards there in time, or do you see empty cards? Also open the link to #clients: does it land on the clients?
options: Empty cards or a wrong landing (say where)

questions.ask: The CTA card's dust on your Mac (Safari) and iPhone: does it look as in the lab, and does the phone stay smooth while it moves (about 217 000 specks there)?
The CTA's lead stays just under 4.5 : 1 over the dust (4.45 at 1440, 4.21 at 390). Keep it, or dim the middle a bit more so it passes?
Which shape for the CTA's dust: as it is on the site now, the burst at the left and right edges (lab of Oct 25), or the one band round the border (lab of Oct 24)?
The ring of covers in Safari on your Mac and iPhone: smooth and sharp? And is it OK that browsers without a real GPU show it still?
options: Smooth, a still ring is fine
A still ring is not fine

questions.ask: Your iPhone turned sideways, in Safari: scroll up and down past the hero. Is the navbar's jump gone, and does it follow smoothly?
On short laptop windows (1366×650, 1280×620) the hero now runs past the first screen and the first card's pill is not seen. Is that OK, or should the team picture be smaller there?
options: Make the picture smaller on short screens

questions.ask: On a wide stack card the drawing is cut at the card's top while the card opens (it stays centred in the open part). Is that the look you wanted?
On your iPhone, scroll to the tools and reload there, in Safari and in Telegram: does the section stay as it is (not white)?
Which Planerka account should the booking window use? flow-medium-8nzjz3/demo (now; shows Planerka's ribbon on the free plan) or t-l-sfkcrg/30min (hides the branding)?
The cookie notice says «Оставаясь, вы даете согласие» (staying = consent), but only «ОК» counts. Change it to «Нажимая «ОК», вы даёте согласие на обработку данных»?
A way to take consent back (e.g. «Настройки куки» in the footer, which shows the notice again): design one now?
The publications include a copy of «Как разобраться в отчетах по роялти» put there to test «Показать больше». Which real publication goes in its place?

On short screens the headings meet: on 1366×650 the hero title is 55px and a section heading 54px; on phones turned sideways a heading is bigger than the hero. Keep a section heading at most the hero ÷ 1.2 on short screens?
For the real host (flowmedium.pro): add HSTS preload? It binds every subdomain to HTTPS for good.
